fato_historico: 1948: A deadly smog event begins in Donora, Pennsylvania, eventually killing 20 and sickening thousands.
energia_do_dia: Today, you may feel an urge to clear the metaphorical fog that has clouded your recent vision. Just as the winds eventually clear the heavy air, it is a good time to let your inner light burn brightly and dissipate any lingering doubts. Consider this a fresh start for your adventurous heart and bold, expansive soul.
frase_do_dia: Let your inner truth shine through even the thickest morning mist.
significado_numero: A powerful gateway for manifestation and higher spiritual awakening.
conselho: Breathe deeply and seek the bright horizon that awaits your arrival today.
